resolution: The placelog the user pasted proved the diagnosis: fresh placements were ON the world lattice, but their 34-piece room sat uniformly OFF by (0.5,0.5) — 1m move steps and Alt placement had put the building on its own lattice, and grid snap only knew the world's, so nothing could ever tile flush with it. Fix extends REQ-0653 (walls anchor to real geometry) to GRID modules: new nearestPlateLatticeAnchor in editors/build/snap.ts finds the closest standing floor/roof plate within plateAnchorMagnetMeters (new tuning row, 3m), and module placements step from that plate's center instead of the world lattice; on a plate top face the anchor is that plate alone (storeys stack on their own building). Composes with req_0668's prefab anchor so a stamp's floors join the adjacent building's grid; iso floor drag-paint fills the same anchored grid; Alt opts out; open ground keeps the world lattice. Snap suite 29/29 (3 new req_0672 cases); cart bundle-checks clean; hot reload picks it up.
